_notes: Story manifest. Each race can map to its own story file; anything unmapped plays default_story.

Story file: title, start (first node), intro ('wake' = eyelids opening, 'fade' = simple fade), characters (who-code -> display name; '' = narration), vars (starting values), places (scene -> location label, optional), show_affinity + affinity_name (optional), nodes.
Node: who, emo, scene, cap (narration shown above the line), text (inline tags [style|words]), reveal (name shown once the typewriter reaches it), choices, redirect, end, end_title, rewind.

Choice: t (button text), to (next node), say (what the log shows you said; defaults to t), aff, q, input (name entry), death (marks Certain Death), fx {add:{var:n}, set:{var:v}}, req {min:{var:n}, max:{var:n}, eq:{var:v}}.
redirect: [{when: <req>, to: node}] — checked on arrival; first match wins.
end: 'win' | 'lose' | 'death'. Shows the ending card. rewind = node 'Try again' returns to (default: start, vars reset).
Styles: big shout laugh whisper cold hot glow forest warm sad fall. Emotions: worried happy laugh incredulous sad thoughtful awe.
Scenes with built-in moods: forest elf pit path clearing beast home night (anything else falls back to forest).

races.name: Human
races.desc: The most common people of Anbur, who chiefly populate the holy land. Less accustomed to the Eternal Forest, but the most versatile of all.

races.name: Elf
races.desc: Their vast knowledge has even led to a moderate understanding of divine power — at the expense of physical capability.

races.name: Dwarf
races.desc: Their reduction in height has done nothing to reduce their physical prowess nor their moderate intelligence — but they see themselves as beyond the need for magic tricks.

races.name: Endigo
races.desc: The tribalistic people of the Eternal Forest, who almost never venture toward the holy lands. A deft understanding of casting magics, but largely naive to the world at large.
